stories.title: Asian Games Softball — Super Round Begins with Japan, China, Chinese Taipei, Philippines

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Asian Games softball Super Round is set.

Japan and China swept the Opening Round unbeaten. Chinese Taipei and Philippines join them.

South Korea is out — eliminated by the Philippines 7-3.

Finals: Oct. 3. LA28 qualification on the line. #Softball #AsianGames2026

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
China beat South Korea 8-4 with THREE home runs in the Asian Games Opening Round.

Japan and China are undefeated. They'll face each other in the Super Round.

This is the most competitive women's softball field in Asia in years. LA28 is watching. #Softball #AsianGames

article.headline: Asian Games Softball Super Round Set — Japan and China Unbeaten as Philippines Stun South Korea

stories.title: Texas Longhorns — Torres + Kavan Fall Debut Is Tomorrow vs. Murray State

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Tomorrow at McCombs Field:

For the first time ever, Isa Torres (.530 BA, 2026 national POY) and Teagan Kavan (2x WCWS MOP — the only player ever) will play on the same team.

Murray State. 6 PM CT. Free admission.

The three-peat starts tomorrow. #HookEm #CollegeSoftball

stories.title: Big Ten Fall Ball — Nebraska's Bahl, Coor, Farrell Impress in Early Action

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Nebraska came within one run of Omaha in 2026. Not this spring.

This fall: Bahl (senior), Coor (OU transfer), Farrell (UNLV transfer).

First game vs. Colorado State: 5-0. All three contributed.

The Cornhuskers are ready. #Huskers #CollegeSoftball

stories.title: Oklahoma Rebuild — Gasso Lands Berzon (LSU), Addresses Transfer Portal Future

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Oklahoma adds 2x NFCA All-American Sydney Berzon (LSU). One year of eligibility.

They lost Milloy, Berkley Zache, Riley Zache to the portal.

Gasso: "We don't need a lot, don't need much at all."

OU isn't done. #Sooners #Softball
